newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Bacob becomes 5th Belgian dlr options market maker.
newsitem.headline: Bacob becomes 5th Belgian dlr options market maker.

text.p: Bacob Bank has become the fifth market maker in U.S. dollar options on Belfox, the Belgian futures and options exchange said in a statement.
It said that Bacob Bank, already market maker in options and futures on Belgian long-term bonds, had joined Nedee, Corluy, Kredietbank and AOT-Belgie last month.

Bacob Bank Managing Director Walter Vanderbeken said in the statement that the bank's new activity fitted within the framework of a "considerable growth in demand of the bank's clients for this instrument listed on Belfox".
